summary_en: Baudroie will cancel 953,455 treasury shares (2.95% of issued shares) effective January 7, 2027, conditional on shareholder approval of a stock split scheduled for January 8, 2027.
title_en: Notice Regarding Cancellation of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief: Baudroie, Inc. announced on October 29, 2026, that its board of directors has resolved to cancel 953,455 treasury shares held by the company, representing 2.95% of issued shares as of October 16, 2026. The cancellation will take effect on January 7, 2027. This action represents the complete disposition of the company's treasury share holdings as of the resolution date. The cancellation is conditional upon shareholder approval of a stock split (with an effective date of January 8, 2027) that was announced concurrently. Following the cancellation, the company's total issued shares will decrease to 31,335,253 shares.
